card.name: Last word of section headings
card.fires_on: The final word or word-ending of a numbered section heading in a drug label, right before the section text starts. Examples are Misuse, Perforation, Ideation, Hepatotoxicity and Information.

modes.label: Heading ending of a warning
modes.description: Last piece of a warnings-and-precautions heading such as Misuse, Perforation or Ideation.
modes.example: 5.2 Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration, and Perfor<<ation>> NSAIDs, including mefenamic acid

modes.label: Dosage heading ending
modes.description: Last word of a dosage section heading such as Information or Instructions.
modes.example: 2.1 Important Dosage and Administration<< Instructions>> Use the lowest effective dosage for the shortest
